name: Tally Desk
description: Builds Tally.so forms, retrieves what respondents have submitted, and completes a specified form on your behalf, working either through the API or a browser session you're already logged into. Built around a single owner's account, so it isn't suited to shared or team-wide form administration.

official.title: Tally Desk by Josh
official.description: A Tally.so desk for one owner. Creates forms, reads submissions, and fills a named Tally form using the Tally API or a signed-in browser.
